title: Pairwise Compatibility Representations of Multidimensional Grid Graphs
summary: Pairwise compatibility graphs (PCGs) represent graph adjacency by an interval of leaf-to-leaf distances in a weighted tree. We study grid graphs under the PCG model and two natural extensions: multi-interval PCGs and OR-PCGs. First, we prove that every $d$-dimensional grid graph is a $(d-1)$-interval-PCG. The construction decomposes the grid into hyperplanes of constant coordinate sum and uses a large-base encoding so that distances between consecutive hyperplanes identify the coordinate direction of an edge.
